counterHypotheses.statement: Off-chain voucher expiration (expiresAt) prevents practical replay.
counterHypotheses.falsificationMethod: Analysis of production expiration windows and execution of test_PropertyA with unexpired timestamp.
counterHypotheses.finding: Vouchers require operational validity buffers (hours to days); intra-window replay is unconstrained.

counterHypotheses.statement: Distribution share caps (_claimable) neutralize the economic impact of replay.
counterHypotheses.falsificationMethod: Comparison of honest vs replay carry fee deduction in test_PropertyC.
counterHypotheses.finding: Share caps bound total token claims, but do not prevent 100% carry fee evasion.

counterHypotheses.statement: Carry fee evasion is temporary and self-corrects in future tranches.
counterHypotheses.falsificationMethod: Analysis of amountClaimedUSDC state variable accumulation and hurdle arithmetic.
counterHypotheses.finding: Under-recording of amountClaimedUSDC distorts hurdle permanently in claimant's favor.

counterHypotheses.statement: withdrawCarry replay is restricted to authorized deal leads.
counterHypotheses.falsificationMethod: Source audit of Distributor.sol:390 and execution of test_withdrawCarry_SignatureReplayExploit.
counterHypotheses.finding: withdrawCarry is permissionless; anyone can replay broadcast calldata.

counterHypotheses.statement: The vulnerability is a duplicate of Cantina Finding #1736.
counterHypotheses.falsificationMethod: Comparative analysis of contract addresses, bytecode, and root causes.
counterHypotheses.finding: #1736 was in EIP-7702 proxy delegation; F-003 is in Echo Distributor. Zero overlap.
